next_step: Deliver Dedicated capacity plan + 90-day cost/latency simulation; schedule procurement call
notes:
Summary:
- Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Building in-app conversational help + contextual recommendations.
- Evaluating Redwood Hosted API first; clear intention to move to Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation once throughput confirmed.

Hosted trial highlights (Jan 15 - Feb 05):
- Trialed hosted text-generation & embeddings for support chat and doc search. 2 engineers + 1 ML lead active.
- Call quote: "Best latency we saw on Redwood hosted in us-west; token-cost still TBD for scale." — Head of ML.
- Key artifacts: trial logs + Fireflies transcripts (ff_2025-01-22-GB-1), security FAQ request sent 2025-01-20.
- Linked drive: pricing deck + security FAQ (drive links above).

POC technical observations (from hosted logs / synthetic load):
- Request mix: 62% short chat turns (<=80 tokens prompt, <=120 tokens completion), 28% doc-search embeddings calls (avg 512-d embed), 10% long synthesis (docs summarization ~1200 prompt / ~300 completion).
- Avg tokens/request during trial: 240 tokens (prompt+completion). Median: 95 tokens.
- Average observed p95 latency (hosted) for generation: 220ms for short queries, 850ms for long synthesis (peaks). Embedding calls ~120ms.
- Concurrency observed (trial peak): 14 concurrent generation workers during demo traffic (non-prod synthetic).

Traffic / Dedicated capacity forecast (Redwood sizing ask):
- Current prod target (Month+3 post-rollout): baseline 30 QPS (all endpoints), peak bursts 120 QPS 10% of the day.
- Concurrency target for Dedicated: sustain 60 concurrent generation streams at p99 SLA (to cover tail and small buffer).
- Token mix estimate (prod): 55% short chat (avg 80 tokens), 35% embeddings (very short/no completion tokens), 10% long synth (avg 1500 tokens).
- Expected token throughput (baseline): ~30 QPS * weighted avg 190 tokens ≈ 5,700 tokens/sec -> ~342k tokens/minute. Peak estimated tokens/minute: ~1.36M tokens/minute.
- Memory/KV cache: heavy prefix reuse for chat sessions (expect 25% of requests to hit prefix cache).
- Batchability: high for embeddings (can batch 16-32), medium for short chat (continuous batching recommended).

POC results & recommendations from SE (Rico Martinez):
- Hosted trial shows model-quality acceptable; need deterministic tail latency guarantees -> move to Dedicated.
- Recommendation: start with 3x A100-equivalent GPU pool (reserved) sized for our model variant quantization profile, with option to burst to 6 GPUs for peak windows.
- Suggest Redwood Optimize tuning: batching/kv-caching to reduce per-token cost by estimated 18-25% at our workload shape.

Commercial / Pricing conversations:
- Customer wants a committed capacity quote + per-token overage rates. Pricing deck discussed on 2025-01-28.
- Concern: need clear mapping from QPS/concurrency to committed monthly spend for procurement.
- Estimate: committed ARR ask target 75k-250k depending on GPU sizing + SLA tier.

Open items / blockers:
- Security: GlassBridge requires SOC2 Type II report and SSO/SAML integration checklist. Security team raised additional data residency questions for EU customers.
- Procurement: finance needs a 3-line budget estimate mapping to GPU-hours and token tiers before legal can start contract.
- Technical: finalizing model selection (open Llama-variant vs tuned proprietary). Need Redwood to confirm supported quantization and compatible kernels for chosen model.

Next steps (owner: Avery Chen):
- 1) Deliver a Dedicated capacity proposal with two scenarios: (A) conservative: 3 GPUs reserved (B) aggressive/burst: 6 GPUs with autoscale + cost simulation for 90 days. Include latency p99 estimates and token pricing mapping. Target delivery: 2025-02-10.
- 2) Deep-dive with GlassBridge security on SOC2 evidence + SSO setup (Rico + Security AE). Schedule week of 2025-02-12.
- 3) Run 48-72h dedicated trial (non-prod) with synthetic peak to validate p99 latency and KV cache hit assumptions.

Quick quotes/snippets from calls:
- "If we can't predict tail latency we'd miss SLAs for our customers" — VP Product.
- "Show us the math mapping tokens -> cost at 1M tokens/minute" — Finance lead (fg_thread).

Sales notes / internal asks:
- SE to build cost model spreadsheet (token mixes, GPU-hours, reserved vs burst) and attach to pricing deck link.
- Ask Solutions Eng to prepare a short runbook for migration from Hosted -> Dedicated (expected friction points: DNS, KMS integration, telemetry forwarding).

Status summary: Qualified and moving into late evaluation; high intent to purchase Dedicated if Redwood can provide a clear capacity plan, SOC2 artifacts, and a 90-day cost/latency simulation.
